latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ifly-text-proofread: proofreads Chinese text for 27 error types using iFlytek's official document proofreading API.
- Supports typos, punctuation, word order, factual errors, and sensitive content detection.
- Handles up to 220,000 characters per request; input can come from command-line text, stdin, or file.
- Pure Python standard library implementation—no external dependencies required.
- Provides clear output with problem highlights, explanations, and correction suggestions.
- Includes detailed setup instructions, error code explanations, and troubleshooting tips.
